metadata.description: Claude Code skills for Android development workflows — feature analysis, QA automation, and more.

plugins.name: feature-analyzer
plugins.description: Pre-dev story interrogation. Team-lead orchestrator walks code + Figma flows, honours project memory, strips out-of-platform sections, and emits a centred dark-mode HTML doc (Linear-style, WCAG AA, violet accent) with the original story pinned alongside option-pill stakeholder questions across PM / Backend / Android / Design / QA / Compliance / DevOps roles — implementation choices the developer decides at code time are auto-suppressed.

plugins.name: qa-autopilot
plugins.description: Automated QA testing — analyzes git branch changes, generates comprehensive test cases, and executes them on a real Android device via phone-driver.

plugins.name: skill-feedback
plugins.description: End-of-session skill auditor that reviews all skills used and raises GitHub Issues with actionable improvement feedback. Includes a PostToolUse hook for automatic skill invocation tracking.

plugins.name: clean-code
plugins.description: Comprehensive guidelines for writing clean, maintainable code following Robert C. Martin's Clean Code principles. Covers naming, functions, classes, comments, formatting, error handling, and testing.

plugins.name: skill-tester
plugins.description: Automated QA loop for Claude Code skills. 3-pane tmux workflow that tests, validates, and fixes skills until production-ready.

plugins.name: bug-finder
plugins.description: Evidence-based bug and crash root cause diagnosis. Disciplined workflow: full flow mapping, hypothesis formation, targeted log verification, and root cause report. Invoke FIRST before any debugging or fixing.

plugins.name: om-pipeline
plugins.description: Supreme 8-stage development pipeline — plan, side-effect analysis, execute with clean code, harsh review, regression check, device testing, and bug fix loops. Commands: /om, /om-bramha, /om-vishnu.

plugins.name: branch-manager
plugins.description: Complete branch dev environment lifecycle — creates git worktrees, dedicated tmux panes with Claude Code, and isolated Android emulators per branch. Interactive cleanup with safety checks.

plugins.name: legacy-refactor
plugins.description: Safe legacy code refactoring guide based on Michael Feathers' "Working Effectively with Legacy Code." Covers seams, characterization tests, dependency breaking, sprout/wrap techniques, and Kotlin/Android patterns.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Claude plugin to Release Builds with correct Release Notes

plugins.name: instructions-feedback
plugins.description: End-of-session auditor that reviews the conversation for instruction corrections and 'always/never' directives, then drafts GitHub Issues proposing amendments to CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, or the project constitution. Every issue is user-approved before creation.

plugins.name: review-pr
plugins.description: Multi-agent PR review — spawns up to 8 grouped review agents in parallel by file type, aggregates findings, filters false positives, and posts inline GitHub comments. Calibration mode (human-in-loop) and autopilot (--auto) mode.

plugins.name: preview-compose
plugins.description: Renders Jetpack Compose @Preview composables on a connected Android emulator from the terminal — no Android Studio needed. Installs the project's debug APK and launches a bundled PreviewActivity with the target preview's FQN. Auto-offers on @Preview edits and runs when the user says 'preview', 'show me', 'render this', or 'on the emulator'.

plugins.name: kmm-migration-workflow
plugins.description: Orchestrates Android-to-KMM migration with behavioral-equivalence safety. Phased workflow — discovery, diagnostic, baseline tests, freeze, git mv + surgical edits, validation, PR. Live-sourced API knowledge (web + Context7), project conventions in .kmm/project.md, diff-confirm scoped to project.md, commit autopilot, per-phase reflective retro.

plugins.name: kmm-pr-review
plugins.description: PR review for Kotlin Multiplatform repos. Spawns specialist subagents per file (correctness, idiom, master-grounded) against canonical JetBrains / Android / SKIE docs — every finding cites a source or is dropped. P0–P3 prioritization with PR-induced vs pre-existing attribution so existing debt never blocks merge; iOS-readiness auto-promotes to P0 on migration PRs.

plugins.name: kmm-debugger
plugins.description: Deep-investigation debugging workflow for KMM post-migration regressions. Hard-gated A/B subagent pair dispatch per topic before any plan or fix, bias guard against defending existing implementation, 'is this even our bug?' as the first question (catches upstream contract violations), Doctrine 3 'always prefer clean long-term solutions over hotfixes / iterative patches', auto-firing retro after each push/PR/publish.

plugins.name: sniper-ops
plugins.description: Day-to-day operational shortcuts for the sniper-v2-android repo. Currently bundles share-prod and share-staging (commit + push + release-notes pre-flight then trigger CircleCI build) and install-prod / install-staging (local install to a connected Android device — auto-launches the app and tails a crash-only logcat in the background on success). Designed to grow as more repetitive ops chores show up.

plugins.name: maestro-android-testing
plugins.description: Maestro UI testing for Android Jetpack Compose apps. Enforces accessibility-ID-first selectors (never coordinates, never ambiguous stock data text), mandatory MCP check before any test authoring, and structured flow headers so AI agents understand context without reading the full YAML. Includes ADB fingerprint bridge for biometric emulator testing.
